classes.reason: the preparation of this view, not part of the running app

roles.purpose: captures the person's speech or typed words and turns them into a request
sends a request to the Jev judgement service or defines what may be sent and read back
changes the working graph or draws it
stores, restores or verifies saved data
holds, passes or requires a credential

relations.purpose: at run time the first sends requests to, or invokes, the second
the first writes or reads saved data in the second
the first uses a credential that comes from the second
the first supplies configuration that the second reads

notAnalyzed: dynamic import() and run-time effects are not analyzed
relations other than static imports are candidates for Jev to judge, never source-declared
an identifier found in a file's text makes a candidate pair, nothing more: it is a string match, not an analysis
an import resolved through the scope's URL mapping rests on that mapping, not on what a server actually serves
a role's node is a term of this scope's vocabulary, not something the code does; a has-role edge is Jev's judgement at that time, and a later judgement of none does not remove it
only packages/voice-ui is in scope; envs, windows and credentials are outside it, and anything outside is unknown
